title: Friends Trivia
shortDescription: Friends Trivia at WesCo Brew & Bowl in Cayce on Tuesday, December 1 at 7:00 PM.
description: Could this BE any more fun? Bring your team to WesCo Brew & Bowl for Friends Trivia with Four Dogs Entertainment. Test your knowledge of Ross, Rachel, Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, and Joey, from Central Perk to your favorite episodes.
